results.summary_before: Crispy VGA takes a VGA signal as input and adds programmable random noise to the video and audio signals before passing them to the output.
results.summary: Crispy VGA takes a standard Tiny Tapeout VGA signal as input and adds a programmable amount of random noise to the video and audio signals before passing them to the output. The uio_in[0] through uio_in[4] inputs individually toggle noise on the hsync, B, G, R, and vsync signals. The uio_in[5] input sets the noise level applied to the R, G, and B wires to high or low, and the uio_in[0:5] inputs set successively increasing noise levels on the audio signal. Testing requires plugging an existing Tiny Tapeout VGA project into the input, connecting the output to a VGA monitor, and selecting the control bits for the desired noise level.
